name: Dumbbell Stability Ball Fly
steps: Sit on the ball with a dumbbell in each hand and walk forward until your upper back and head are supported.
Lift your hips and hold the dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms wide to the sides in a controlled arc until you feel a comfortable stretch across your chest.
Squeeze your chest muscles to bring the dumbbells back together over your chest along the same arc.
tips: Keep your glutes engaged and hips level so the ball does not wobble from side to side.
Hold the slight bend in your elbows steady instead of bending them deeply into a press.
